column1: # Names the corpus applies on top of the Ghidra dump.
# tier: binary = the image states it (a VProf scope, RTTI, an export)
#       doc    = a docs/ topic file states it beside the address
#       inferred = argued from call sites or slot position, and nothing else
# `corpus names --apply` writes these; `build` and `reindex` re-apply them. A row
# removed from this file is reverted to whatever the dump called it. A row that
# disagrees with a name the dump recovered is reported and NOT applied.
